plan.title: Phase 0 - Characterization tests before any refactor

narratives.Overview: BLOCKING PREREQUISITE. Capture current behaviour as tests so the optimisations that follow can be proven not to change it. Required by personal standards: characterization tests precede refactoring legacy code.
narratives.Problem: F1, F5 and F6 all rewrite how existing values are produced. Without a pinned record of current output, a regression is indistinguishable from an intended change.
narratives.Action:
Add to LibraryCore/Tests/LibraryCoreTests, extending the existing ContactSheetServiceTests and VideoDuplicateAnalyzerTests suites:

- F1: frame timestamps and ordering produced for a 4x4 grid over fixture videos
- F5: asset sort-by-size ordering for an unchanged library
- F6: duration, dimensions and codec as AVFoundation reports them today

These must pass unchanged after every optimisation in this epic.
narratives.Test: Run with `swift test --package-path LibraryCore`. The Auditor executes and reads real output.
